doc: AudioDirector rule tables (P1.12, extended P2.16). Sources: docs/04 §1-§7, docs/02 §2.1-§2.2, docs/02 §5, docs/10 §5. TurnSchema consumes stage_gates.json for the dynamic schema; AudioDirector enforces the same gates again at play time (never trust the model). stage_layers/voice_blips are P2.16's per-stage layers (docs/04 §2 drift, §7 blips).
music_gate_doc: docs/02 §2.2 offers dread/distorted from stage 3, but docs/04 §8.3 maps no track for either before stage 4 (docs/04 §2: '—' at stage 2-3). The audio gate follows the track map, so a stage-3 request is denied 'gated' — DCR P2.16-1 asks the producer to align docs/02 §2.2 + stage_gates.json to 4 (or to commission a stage-3 drone).

cue_budget.doc: docs/02 §5: stage 0-1 = 1 cue per 2 turns, 2-3 = 1 per turn, 4-5 = 2 per turn. Token bucket: every begin_turn adds per_turn, capped at cap; a played cue costs 1.0.

stage_layers.doc: docs/04 §1-§2 stage drift on the Music bus: the pitch drifts -5 cents per stage and the low-pass closes 1 kHz per stage after stage 2. The docs give no absolute cut-off base; 12 kHz at stage 2 is the chosen base so the drift is audible without muffling (P2.16 deviation note). Distortion/reverb are the docs/04 §1 'driven by stage' effects — drive/wet per stage, effect bypassed while zero.

voice_blips.doc: docs/04 §4/§7 and docs/10 §5: a soft blip every 2-3 revealed characters, pool chosen by voice_by_stage (game/data/casting.json), pitched by the beat's feeling (feelings[f].voice.pitch_st/gain_db; null voice = no blips). Stage 5 keeps the stage-4 whisper blips as its base and mixes the demon pool under them 30% of the time.
